text: A number of studies have been carried out to determine protein requirements for those involved in resistance training. Lemon and colleagues (76) found that novice bodybuilders in the early phase of intense training required approximately 1.6 to 1.7 g/kg/day-approximately double the RDA. These findings have been confirmed by other researchers (135). Moreover, meta-analytic data comprising 49 longitudinal studies on protein supplementation combined with regimented resistance exercise reaches similar conclusions as well (95). This increased protein requirement is necessary to offset the oxidation of amino acids during exercise as well as to supply substrate for lean tissue accretion and the repair of exercise-induced muscle damage (22).
